# Goblins of the Wastes

The goblin tribes of the wastes. Every goblin tribe is a clan, and every
goblin clan has a warlord, a shaman, and a hundred goblin-spears.

Goblins scout the toll road. The goblin clans and the duke's agents have
an arrangement: goblins raid the road, the duke's agents take the credit,
and the goblin clans are paid in ducats from the garrison's smuggling
fund.

Each goblin clan knows the road's schedule better than the garrison does.
A goblin raid on the second bridge is a goblin clan's answer to being
underpaid.

Goblins do not keep letters. The duke's letters are all written by the
spymaster, and the goblins know a goblin cannot read them.

Related: [[Duke Reynard]], [[The Toll Road]]
